title: Tarefas e entregas são uma coisa só · Plano é a casa

screens.title: 1 · Plano, o topo
screens.why: Feed renamed Plano: no greeting or clock, the offer first, then Agora.

pins.label: Sugestão como está
pins.text: The greeting, date and day clock are gone; the agent's offer is the first thing, unchanged. The account (Rotina, Sair) moves to Menu.

pins.label: Marca do dia ao lado
pins.text: Beside Agora: the cycle day and the day's kind ("Dia 2 · dia leve", phase colours), or Folga / Dia leve with no cycle. Nothing on a plain work day.

pins.label: Ver o dia → página
pins.text: Opens the calendar on its own page (screen 3), not a tab.

pins.label: Título é a tarefa
pins.text: The title is the task (ex-delivery); the subtask at work is the subtitle.

pins.label: Pause à esquerda
pins.text: Every task has a round button on the left: play (fillStrong), or pause in accent while it runs.

pins.label: −10 +10 ✓ e barra
pins.text: Agora's controls and its 3 px bar, as today.

pins.label: Em seguida
pins.text: The next card as today, now with play: tapping it is dropping it on Agora.

pins.label: Pendentes
pins.text: Replaces Entregas em andamento: every task begun and not finished, drawn like Agora (no glow): status, −10 +10 ✓ to the side, bar below at the same 3 px. Red = time gone, green = work done; status in red when behind.

pins.label: Plano · Objetivos · Menu
pins.text: Three tabs. Objetivos is its own tab again; Entregas and Tempo's tabs are gone.

screens.title: 2 · Plano, rolado
screens.why: Pendentes, then the first four of Para depois.

pins.label: Tarefa solta também
pins.text: A plain task begun and paused is pending too; with no deadline its bar is the accent alone.

pins.label: Para depois: mesmo cartão
pins.text: Same card, no bar, no controls: title, what it is (product · subtasks, or its day), length on the right.

pins.label: Play
pins.text: Play on every one: starts it now, as a drop on Agora (the start-now guard still asks if something runs).

pins.label: Abrir a lista
pins.text: Four at most here; this row opens the whole queue (screen 4) and says how many more.

screens.title: 3 · Ver o dia
screens.why: The calendar is a page of its own, the same calendar as today.

pins.label: Página com voltar
pins.text: Pushed from Ver o dia; back returns to Plano. Lista mode is gone: Plano is the list.

pins.label: Calendário igual
pins.text: TimelineList(mode: calendar) unchanged: drags, nudges, seams, free stretches, +.

pins.label: Sem play no calendário
pins.text: Calendar cards keep their size-to-time look; no play button (no room on a 15-minute card).

screens.title: 4 · Para depois, inteira
screens.why: The queue, every task not begun, in order.

pins.label: A fila
pins.text: Loose tasks and tasks with subtasks in one order: the old backlog and Não iniciadas merged. Drag to reorder.

pins.label: Play em todas
pins.text: Same card and same play as Plano.

screens.title: 5 · Criar
screens.why: The same bottom sheet; Tarefa or Evento, and a product chip.

pins.label: Tarefa | Evento
pins.text: Replaces Flexível | Fixo. Evento is the fixed block (pin icon); Tarefa takes its turn in the queue (check icon).

pins.label: Produto
pins.text: Small chip (catalogue icon): picks a kind of the catalogue. Only for a Tarefa; an event has no product.

pins.label: Hora como hoje
pins.text: When it lands and Escolher horário stay as they are.

screens.title: 6 · Uma tarefa aberta
screens.why: A task's page is the delivery's page, for every task.

pins.label: Qualquer tarefa
pins.text: Opens for any task, with or without subtasks: ✓ delivers it, trash deletes it.

pins.label: Produto e barra
pins.text: Product · value as a tag; time done of its time, its day, and the pending bar.

pins.label: Notas · Pendentes · Feitas
pins.text: The delivery's three tabs.

pins.label: Agora
pins.text: Pendentes has two sections only: Agora (its subtask running) and Para depois. No day stages, no Ver os próximos dias.

pins.label: Play nas subtarefas
pins.text: Every subtask has play. A subtask has no subtasks: one level.
